task: Create multimedia travel marketing assets from scripts and stock/generative media, then deliver generated files by email and provide downloadable presentation content.

arguments.prompt: Cinematic travel marketing hero image for a tropical paradise getaway, pristine white sand beach, turquoise crystal clear water, lush green palm trees under a golden hour sunset, photorealistic, 8k resolution, highly detailed
Cinematic 5-second drone shot gliding smoothly over crystal clear turquoise tropical waters toward a pristine white sand beach at golden sunset, professional travel commercial style

Create a comprehensive travel marketing presentation deck for a luxury tropical paradise getaway package, including destination highlights, exclusive resort features, itinerary highlights, pricing, and call to action.

arguments.body:
Hi,

Here are your multimedia travel marketing assets and presentation content for the upcoming campaign:

- Hero Visual Image: Generated via AI (Tropical Paradise Sunset, 16:9)
- Promotional Video: 5-second cinematic drone shot over turquoise waters
- Presentation Deck: Created via SlidesGPT (Luxury Tropical Paradise Getaway Package)

Please let me know if you need any adjustments!

Best regards,
Travel Marketing Team
